name: Cerro Guanaco
why: The hardest hike in the park and its best view: the Beagle Channel, Lapataia bay and Lago Acigami from 970 m.
book: Park entry ticket at the gate. Trekking registration is compulsory: at the Alakush visitor centre or online on the park's site. The park closes the trail in winter.
water: Only at the start: carry 2 litres.
dangers: A peat bog half way that swallows boots after rain.
The summit ridge is slate scree in strong wind; snow possible all summer.
turnaround: Park rule: no climbing after 12:00. If you are not at the bog by then, turn back.

points.name: Lago Acigami (Lago Roca)
points.note: The Lago Acigami car park. The first 900 m are shared with the Hito XXIV path, then the trail turns into the forest and climbs.

points.name: Cerro Guanaco peat bog
points.note: A flat, wet valley at about 680 m, two thirds of the way: the last easy ground before the steep slate.

points.name: Cerro Guanaco
points.note: 973 m. The Beagle Channel, Lapataia bay, Lago Acigami and the Chilean border mountains.
